english: You approach a ball of feathers and wings and really, really sharp claws.
A magnificent creature.
Too bad he's clearly overfed.
That is rude. The poor bird-cat has a unique body shape, and we should celebrate that.
If it could understand you, sure.
Magical beasts can sometimes understand basic common. You could try speaking with it.
It's a griffon, right?
This is a griffon. It is a somewhat intelligent magical beast.
You will require Speak with Animals to communicate properly, of course.
Simply cast Speak with Animals. That should lessen the pain of negotiation.
You see a pool of drool forming underneath the open beak of the beast.
It is asleep.
Wait, look behind it.
Oh. Wait. Isn't that...
There's an entrance to the Warehouse on the other roof. If you want to get inside, you're going to have to get past this bad boy.
The mythical beast snores gently before you.
I don't even want to ask what the plan is here.
The mythical beast looks at you - with intelligent eyes.
Hungry eyes.
(Pet the bird.)
E-"Thank you for your time, griffon."
Not a bird.
A large bird.
(Pet the dangerous monster.)
(Pet the large bird.)
Better.
You reach forth, and the griffon snaps at you with its beak.
Almost got you. Careful.
Its eyes say, 'Cut that shit out, biped.'
Not a fan, huh.
R-(Attempt to pet the beast.)
Wake the animal gently, through understanding and empathy.
R-(Attempt to sneak past it.)
E-"Okay. I've come to a conclusion. I should not engage this beast right now."
No. No, thank you.
And seriously, be careful. I'm not cleaning up your guts if that thing skewers you.
You go in, and...
(Pet.)
How does one do this?
You try to see from the beast's perspective.
How would you like to be awoken, if you had to be awoken from your lovely slumber, if you had to be awoken from your lovely slumber by a helmed handsome stranger?
If you had to be awoken from your lovely slumber by a helmed handsome stranger on a day such as this?
I lost my train of thought. What am I doing?
The question is: by which method would you like to be awoken?
I don't know. A hug?
Okay. Try that then.
Come here, birdy... (Give the sleeping griffon a hug.)
Alright, let's do this...
Sorry? What are you doing?
Sneak past it.
No, no. I regret this. Let's not.
You take a deep breath.
Then you take the first step.
The goblin follows right behind you as you carefully navigate the ledge of the roof.
You carefully navigate the ledge of the roof.
One wrong step and you fall. One wrong step in the other direction, and the bird will slap you off.
But...
You take a deep breath as you make it to the other side.
Let's not do that again.
(Start walking away.)
Oh.
The griffon appears to have awoken.
You got here just in time!
Perfect. Now we can make it back too.
Sometimes you're a really lucky bastard, you know that?
E-At least it didn't try to eat me.
Right on the beast's wing.
Tsk. Fine. Whatever.
Regret what? What's happening?
A light tap.
...<shake>Goddamn it</shake>! you hear your companion yell, and rushing down to the street.
(Land.)
The bones in your body cracking.
Hard ground merging with your flesh.
But you live.
(Groan.)
Almost got it.
That did not go so well.
Perhaps another method shall work better?
Gods-be-damned. What were you thinking?! you hear Snell yell at you as he comes running down the street.
The goblin eventually makes it down to you, gasping for air. "It's good you're alive, but seriously-  isn't there a saying about NOT waking a sleeping griffon?"
Don't do that again.
E-Ouch.
How does one wake a sleeping grumpy creature?
Poke it?
Scream at it?
Hug it?
No.
Almost. But not.
Not immediately, no.
The answer is simple.
You sing.
(Clear your throat, excitedly.)
Cleric.
The goblin hisses at you and points at the claws. "Sharp."
A little lullaby will do.
Oh, little birdy. Spread your wings. Don't be afraid of the deep dark things. Crawling and creeping and being so bad, everybody wants you to not be sad.
Oh. So... you can get past now.
Did you... make that up on the spot?
The beast didn't slash your throat. Yet.
Wonderful.
Thank you, griffon.
It yawns in a way you didn't think creatures with beaks could do, and gives you a tired look.
I can't believe that worked. I can't believe you're alive, the goblin mutters under his breath as he too slowly shimmies past the beast.
E-Sometimes it pays off to be handsome and talented.
Your spell causes you to feel lighter for a moment, as if connected with the soaring dreams of the griffon.
Then it fades as a deep growling voice enters your ears.
<wiggle>...</wiggle>
<wiggle>...You...</wiggle>
<wiggle>...Foolish...</wiggle>
...Biped.
The griffon gets up from its slumber with a dark groan.
Ugh...
How many times must I make it clear...
I require rest. Or do you wish to taste my steel?
Holy shit, you can talk!
Good morning, sleepyhead.
I apologize, oh great griffon.
Of course. You foolish biped.
Steel it is, then?
He scoffs. "You think me weak to flattery, eh?"
The beast spreads its wings. "You may address me as Giorgio Valzantigo."
Master Giorgio Valzantigo.
If griffons could smirk, he would.
Who does this chicken think he is?!
The bird... will shred you...
Wow. This beast lives on a pedestal.
Whatever it says: just play along.
Greetings, Master. Thank you for getting out of the way.
You're not my master!
(Bow.) "Hello, griffon."
Pff.
You're welcome, biped.
I suppose that's true.
He grunts. "If I was in a worse mood, I'd slash your throat, biped."
But a featherless freak could only act so gently. Clearly.
Tsk.
Your manners are in the gutters, along with your bloodline.
Harsh.
Even by bird standards.
Now, I am in a good mood after my nap. Go ahead.
Ask me whatever inane questions you might have.
How'd you get that name, Giorgio?
Why do you call me 'biped'?
What do you do around here?
Sleep well?
You're kind of chunky.
That's it for now. Thanks. (Break the spell.)
My father was Tizz'lamiergi Valzantigo of House Valzantigo.
We are bred to be perfect, the griffon growls, leaning his beak in towards your face.
Interesting. This griffon must be one of Vetta Dei Re. Typical racing breed.
Those names sound very gnomish. You seem to remember there is some kind of secret connection between them and griffons.
I see. So you originate from Vetta Dei Re.
Your name sounds kind of gnomish? Why?
That is correct. Of course you've heard of my home-kingdom.
Of course. The biped is knowledgeable in basic history.
The bird lets out a squawk.
I originate from Vetta Dei Re.
VDR is the greatest city on the Coast.
The gnomes who live there have served my lineage for over a century-and-a-half.
Once I finish this obligation in the west, I will return to rule my house once more.
Soon enough. Soon enough.
Why? For that is what you are.
A two-legged featherless biped.
Do you disagree?
I do! (Get ready to argue about your identity as a person.)
No, that's factually correct.
Of course. And what incorrectness will you spew in my direction, then?
I am actually a really cool rogue.
You may call me 'wizard'.
THE CLERIC. That is what I am.
Don't be rude. I'm trying to tell you about my identity here.
Rogue? Like... a rapscallion?
Yeah, the sneaky kind.
Yeah, the fun kind.
No. I'm really unfun and serious, all the time.
I don't know why I asked.
Wizard...
Ah. That is why you suddenly learned to communicate. You are cheating!
Yes. With magic. I am very smart.
I wouldn't call it that.
You're the one who learned to talk!
For a biped, mayhaps.
I don't care what you would call it.
No.
He chuckles.
No, you.
But you are magical. Just like my wonderful gnomish servants, then.
A knack of magic is a good trait in a servant, you see. You should consider bending the knee.
It would be good for you.
I don't know what that is, and I don't care.
Anything else?
That is not something I have ever heard of - so perhaps yes. Either way, it's dumb.
A bird?
No. A Barb.
Ah. I don't care.
Perhaps. I do not care.
Rude? I am just realistic, biped.
But fine. Tell me. What are you?
It is. Biped.
I handle scouting for the boat-bipeds. Though they do not hold any interest for my valuable information.
Some of the less rugged ones I even move around from time to time. I traveled with one a few days ago, all the way to this strange, cold land.
In return, I get fed a glorious amount of sustenance.
More than you could ever wish for, biped.
Noticeable.
Who's your owner?
Who did you fly with here?
...Got it.
Tsk. I have no owners, you foolish thing.
You need to wrap your mind around a superior being not needing to slave away all day. Learn from me.
That would do you good.
All that <u>ego</u> - with no intellect.
How sad.
A biped of your size, approximately.
One with a gaudy sense of style. Some type of ground-delver of a human, I believe. The type to head deep below, and not come back for many, many days.
It's sad, really. To be a biped. Like you.
We could find its owner below, then.
Ah. It is speaking of Meriadoc. This is the Trade Prince's griffon, surely.
What a lovely creature.
Until you showed up, yes.
I had a dream where I kept smacking bipeds like you around.
It was wonderful.
Fed well. Yes, thank you.
I am very rich, indeed.
He doesn't see that as an insult?
Weird bird.
The voice disappears from the griffon immediately.
Had a good chat? Didn't sound like you were best friends exactly.
E-Time to go.
You've essentially been squawking for a while now.
I would've laughed- if the noises coming from that griffon didn't scare the shit out of me.
Sounded like you'd be gutted any second.
That sounds scary. Oh well.
The griffon and I came to an understanding. I think.
Let us not talk about it anymore.
Sure. Let's go before the bird changes its mind.
